description: Per-NodeKind render-fidelity declaration for the Fuaran UI wire format. For each canonical kind.$type: what the wire carries (source), what the parity-checked render pins (fallback), and what, if anything, is declared client-only rich. Generated from Fuaran.UI.RenderFidelity; it transcribes the shipped fidelity contracts and introduces no wire or renderer behaviour. A consumer deriving per-node fidelity badges reads this rather than hand-annotating. Each kind also declares the checkable render obligations it owes, drawn from the closed obligationVocabulary and bound to the spec section that states each one; a host render suite asserts every obligation for the kinds it renders and REPORTS any it cannot check, because not checked is not passed. Each kind also declares its INTRINSIC ARIA: the roles and live regions the renderer emits whatever the node's accessibility trait says, with the condition where the emission turns on the kind's own spec and the tier that emits it. A consumer reads that to know whether a kind is already announced before authoring a trait it does not need; an empty array means the kind announces nothing of itself. Beside kinds, traits declares the obligations owed for a member that rides the node envelope rather than any one kind - a trait is identified by the wire path of the member it governs, names the kinds it applies to, and draws its claim ids from the same closed obligationVocabulary, so a host reports an unchecked trait claim exactly as it reports an unchecked kind claim. Each kind also declares its SPEECH ruling: what a speech projection says for the kind when a node carries no accessibility.speak of its own, drawn from the closed speechClasses (spoken, derived, announced-only, omitted) with the per-kind derivation as a note. Each kind also declares its ADAPTIVE CARD ruling: what a projection to an Adaptive Card (schema 1.4) does with the kind, drawn from the closed adaptiveCardClasses (mapped, structural, open-live, flatten-to-text, omitted), with the card element types the node itself may emit and the per-kind rule as a note. See WIRE_FORMAT.md 13.

tiers.meaning: the deterministic, parity-clean data the wire carries; never a rendered form
the deterministic render the SSR-parity corpus and the cross-host byte-diff compare - what a no-JS reader, a crawler, or a non-browser host gets
the declared client-only render, explicitly outside every parity comparison rather than silently divergent

speechClasses.meaning: the kind's authored prose is read aloud as written
the utterance is composed from what the node already carries - typed fields, a heading, its accessible label, its children in authored order
the node is announced as what it is and its content is never pretended at - an interactive or client-drawn surface a listener cannot operate
nothing is said, and the node is reported in the projection's omission list rather than dropped

adaptiveCardClasses.meaning: the kind projects to its Adaptive Card counterpart
the node lays out its children in a Container or ColumnSet, and the children project
a labelled Action.OpenUrl to the live surface, or a labelled note when none is declared; never a half-working control
the content survives as literal text in a RichTextBlock; the form does not
nothing is emitted, and the node is named in the projection's degradation list

obligationVocabulary.meaning: an accessible name is emitted on every instance of the kind, never only where an author supplied one
autoplay is emitted only together with muted; neither attribute ever appears without the other
a variant declaring no autoplay slot emits no autoplay pathway at all - neither the attribute nor its pair
a secondary source the URL-scheme and egress floor refuses is dropped rather than emitted at the refusal URL
the alternative-text attribute is emitted always, the empty string included - absent and empty are different claims
a declared expansion emits a real working anchor to the full-size asset, honoured with no script at all
a source the egress floor refused emits no affordance - an expansion that cannot be honoured is worse than none
the caption sits outside the expansion anchor, so the caption text is not part of the link target
responsive candidates are emitted in ascending width order, and a refused candidate is dropped rather than emitted

an unregistered custom node with an available contract card renders a labelled placeholder derived from that card - identity, summary and a machine-readable verdict marker - never a blank and never a guess
repeated children are emitted in the authored order the wire carries, never re-sorted
at most one repeated child per declared kind carries the default marker; a later duplicate election is emitted without it
a declared transcript renders as a disclosure beside the transport, carrying its own accessible name

the sandbox declaration is emitted on every instance, empty when nothing is granted, and carries exactly the declared relaxations - de-duplicated, in declaration order, and never a token the document did not name
a primary source the egress floor refuses omits the source attribute entirely rather than pointing the browsing context at the refusal URL, while still recording the refusal

a declared ingress gesture is additional: the file picker and its label are emitted whatever the document declares, so the keyboard-accessible route survives and a no-script host renders a working upload
the aria-modal inertness claim is emitted for the blocking modality alone; a non-blocking anchored surface carries the dialog role without it, because the page behind it is genuinely still available
each declared ceiling is recorded as read with a marker carrying no value, and an undeclared ceiling emits no marker at all - the value is withheld because nothing in this tier can act on it
a declared text direction is emitted on the element carrying the node's run, so the run resolves in the declared direction rather than from its own characters
a declared run is isolated from the surrounding bidirectional context, so the text around it is not reordered by the value
a declaration wins over any direction the host would otherwise infer or inherit for that node
the identity value of a declaration is the absence of one - a node declaring it renders byte-identically to the same node omitting the member
no further behaviour is derived from the declaration - not a layout side, not a locale, not an alignment, and not a direction for descendants

a rendered grid row carries the interactive-row class only where the grid declares a row action, and a grid declaring none carries it on no row - the pointer affordance keyed on that class promises a click exactly where the document declared one

a resolved float sequence yields exactly one reading per element - an element that is not a number reads as the non-finite sentinel in its own position, and neither shortens the series nor suppresses the rest of it
the element accept set at a float-sequence slot is closed - a JSON number or one of the three quoted sentinel spellings, and no other spelling of a number

kinds.source: the column declarations, the row-source binding, the declared sort / page / edit intent, and the two Phase 1473 print-break declarations
kinds.fallback: in static read-only mode the full semantic `<table class="fuaran-table">` (byte-identical to the retired `Table`, with the declared sort surfaced as `data-fuaran-sort-*`); a static table's declared `columns` are read by position (`columns[j]` describes every row's cell `j`), and a `TonedPill` column draws its cell as `<span class="fuaran-grid-cell-pill fuaran-pill-<tone>">` holding the cell's own text, toned by the map entry for the row's value at the pill's `field` (a static row reads as each declared column's `field` mapped to its cell's text) - a class plus text, never colour alone, and every other cell plain text; a static table whose `rowKeyField` names a declared column's `field` is selectable - a row click publishes the row's record under the table's id, and the row whose key is the selection's (a designed selection is a `Selection` on the table projecting that field with a `defaultValue`, laid under the host's selections before the first render) carries `fuaran-grid-row-selected` and `aria-selected="true"`; a bound grid whose source resolves where the page is rendered (a pipeline over an embedded table, a state source with a default, a host query whose rows the host supplied) is the reference grid's own `<table class="fuaran-grid">` as the first-party client draws it before any interaction - the declared columns in order (`fuaran-grid-header`), each row a `fuaran-grid-row` and each display cell a `<span>` inside a `fuaran-grid-cell` holding the value through the column's declared format, the effective sort applied, the requested page with the renderer-owned pager (`fuaran-grid-paged`, inert until hydration), the window a `windowStateKey` presents - so a hydrating client attaches to markup it already agrees with, and the affordances that need script (sorting, paging, editing, reordering, transfer) switch on at hydration; a host states a row limit (1000 rows in the reference server renderer), past which it draws the first rows and states the total (`aria-rowcount` and the pager status), never the whole table; a bound grid whose source does not resolve where the page is rendered (a host query with no rows supplied, a state source with no default) is a deterministic `fuaran-grid-ssr-placeholder` carrying `data-fuaran-row-count` and naming why - never a blank. A declared `keepRowsTogether` / `repeatHeader` is carried as the `fuaran-grid-rows-together` / `fuaran-grid-repeat-header` class on EVERY leg - on a table the reference stylesheet's `@media print` rules then reach its rows and its header row group with no script at all, and on the placeholder the class records that the declaration was read and survives to the hydrated grid. A declared `exportable` (Phase 1125) reaches NEITHER leg: the export control is drawn only where it can act, so a server-rendered grid emits the markup it emitted before the affordance existed and the declaration rides the wire to the client tier

traits.summary: the declared base direction of ONE value's own run - the only `SemanticStyle` member that is not presentational, and a correctness statement rather than a stylistic one: a value declared `ltr` inside right-to-left prose is reordered by the Unicode bidirectional algorithm unless the run is isolated, and the reader then reads its digits back in the wrong order

obligations.statement: a node whose `style.direction` is `ltr` or `rtl` emits that direction on the element carrying the node's own run - as HTML `dir`, or the receiving surface's equivalent - so the run resolves in the declared direction rather than from its own characters

the declared run is ISOLATED from the surrounding bidirectional context (`unicode-bidi: isolate`, a `<bdi>` element, or the surface's equivalent). Direction without isolation is half the contract and leaves the neighbouring text reordered around the value

the declaration WINS over any direction the host would otherwise infer for that node, an inherited one from an enclosing declared run included - the inference exists for values whose direction is unknown, the declaration for the values the inference gets wrong

`auto` is the ABSENCE of a declaration: a node declaring `auto` renders identically in every respect to the same node omitting the member, so the claim is a byte comparison of the two emissions rather than an assertion that nothing is emitted

nothing else is derived from it: not a layout side, not a locale, not a text alignment, and not a direction for the node's descendants beyond whatever the receiving surface's own inheritance already does - so a declared run's emission differs from the undeclared one by the direction and its isolation alone
